implemented.format: uint16 little-endian fixed rows of T+1 tokens; x=row[:-1],y=row[1:]

implemented.restart_contract: Checkpoint cursor after last optimized batch. If prefetching, persist prefetch batch/cursor BEFORE next read, or disable prefetch. Exact reader state alone does not save optimizer/RNG.
